curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As an elusive predator stalks 1970s Hamburg, see how a pervasive wave of terror slowly takes hold across the city.
curatedMovie.description: In early 1970s Hamburg, an unsettling serial killer preys on the city's vulnerable margins, spreading dread across local neighborhoods in director Fatih Akin's grim period crime portrait.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful, and grimly unsettling; a dark period crime study best experienced alone with undivided focus.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Fatih Akin crafts a gritty, unflinching collision of crime, horror, and macabre comedy, capturing a city gripped by genuine dread with intense, focused precision.
